groups.problem: Delegating CombinedRule abilities to the ruler helper discards federation status and enables modification of previously immutable federated rules.
groups.rationale: All three describe the same lost federation check during delegation. Preserving or passing through that status resolves every report.

groups.problem: Prometheus-only list items expose Silence notifications, but the silence drawer requires a ruler rule and never opens.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same caller and ruler-only drawer guard, with the same consequence when the Silence action is clicked.
